_comment: Hand corrections per game frame for render-sword.ps1: fields replace those in frames.json. Owner, 10 Nov 2026: no reverse grip anywhere - a raised fist holds the blade up and back over the head before a blow, never point-down like a dagger; a calm fist holds it forward and a little up (about 15 degrees, render-sword.ps1 -CalmMatch).
_run: The blade follows the swinging fist forward and down instead of trailing back from a forward fist.
_jump: Fist out in front at the top of the jump: the blade forward, as in the frames around it.
_spin: Coil before the spin: the blade upright before the chest, not back and down across the body.
_exec_moth: Standing with the blade forward and down; the raise holds it up and back, then the blows go forward.
_exec_racer: Both raises hold the blade up and back; after the second blow she wrenches it out and lifts it back over her head.
_exec_sheet: The raised fist holds the blade up and back before cutting the sheet along the floor.
_exec_card: Stance forward and down; the wind-up up and back over the shoulder, then the blow into the card.
_finisher: The whip between the coiled back swing and the full extension: the blade still lags behind the fist, pointing at the viewer, shortened, the trail just starting under the body.
_airslash: The extension frame is used twice; the second carries the blade on round to the far side.
